[UPSC CSE 2023] Q1. Consider the following statements regarding the Indus Valley Civilization:
1. Harappa was excavated before Mohenjo-daro.
2. The Great Bath was discovered at Mohenjo-daro.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

answerExplanation.text: Harappa was excavated in 1921 by Daya Ram Sahni. Mohenjo-daro was excavated in 1922 by R.D. Banerji. The Great Bath was discovered at Mohenjo-daro. Both statements are correct.
